violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY VACUUM-PACKAGED YELLOWTAIL THAWING IN THE WALK-IN COOLER IN INTACT PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND PIC REMOVED FISH FROM THE PACKAGING. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAWING COMMERCIALLY VACUUM-PACKAGED FISH SHOULD BE REMOVED FROM THE PACKAGING OR THE PACKAGING SHOULD BE SLIT OPEN WHEN THE THAWING PROCESS BEGINS. RESTAURANT ARIAKE (Inspection Date: 07/22/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED FAR RIGHT END SUSHI DISPLAY CASE AT 43F WITH EHS THERMOMETER AND MIDDLE RIGHT SUSHI DISPLAY CASE AT 41F WITH EHS THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED SOME OF THE FOOD ITEMS IN THESE COOLERS AND WILL DISCARDED OF THE REST OF THE TCS FOOD ITEMS AT THE END OF THE LUNCH SERVICE (LESS THAN 4 HOURS). PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS SHOULD BE KEPT BETWEEN 34-38F TO ENSURE COLD HOLDING FOODS ARE KEPT PROPERLY. PLEASE ENSURE THEY ARE REPAIRED/ADJUSTED PRIOR TO USING THEM AGAIN. EHS ALSO RECOMMENDS TO ENSURE FISH THAT IS STORED IN THESE COOLERS TO BE FULLY COOLED AFTER PREPARATION TO 41F OR BELOW PRIOR TO PUTTING THEM INTO THE SUSHI DISPLAY CASES.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND PIC REMOVED Y SPLITTER DURING INSPECTION. PIC WILL ENSURE APPROVED DUAL BLEED VALVE IS INSTALLED IF THE FACILITY WISHES TO HAVE TWO FAUCETS AT THE MOP SINK.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED BEAN SPROUTS AT 58F ON SHELF, ROE AT SUSHI LINE AT 52F, AND COOKED CHICKEN MEATBALLS AT 50F IN TWO-DOO PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED ALL FOOD ITEMS TO A COOLER/BELOW PREP-TOP. PROPER ICE BATH AND PREP-TOP USAGE WAS DISCUSSED. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION,.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2-DOOR PREP TOP, MIDDLE + LEFT SUSHI DISPLAY CASE AND RIGHTMOST SUSHI DISPLAY CASE WITH A FOOD THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.PLEASE ENSURE ALL UNITS HAVE AN ACCURATE UNIT THERMOMETER.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED SOME IN-USE UTENSILS IN STANDING AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER; OBSERVED KNIFE STORED BETWEEN PREP TOP UNIT AND WALL.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WAS DISCUSSED WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ROE AT 48F AND SCALLOPS AT 42-45F ON ICE BATHS IN SUSHI BAR AREA; FOOD HAD BEEN ON ICE FOR APPROXIMATELY 30 MINUTES.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC ADDED MORE ICE AND COLD WATER TO ICE BATHS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS IF ICE BATHS ARE GOING TO BE USED FOODS/CONTAINERS SHOULD BE FULLY IMMERSED IN ICE TO ENSURE FOODS REMAIN AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL STORED NEXT TO DISHWASHING MACHINE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC UNDERSTANDS RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL MAY NOT BE USED ON THE PREMISES. FACILITY HAS A CONTRACT WITH COMMERCIAL PEST CONTROL COMPANY. PIC DISCARDED OF PEST CONTROL DURING INSPECTION.
